title: Hannibal ambushes the Romans at Lake Trasimene
summary: Hannibal trapped a Roman army under the consul Gaius Flaminius on the northern shore of Lake Trasimene and destroyed it. Flaminius was killed.
reason: During the Second Punic War Hannibal had crossed the Alps and was seeking to break Roman power in Italy.
significance: It remains one of the largest ambushes in military history and spread panic in Rome.
